sgp_meta.note: 1 game(s) on this card carry a rated leg and 1 carry a shoppable line row. ⛔ No combined chance is published for a same-game slip and no EV is either — the legs are correlated, so the product of their records would be a percentage asserting something false. The payout shown is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book will pay for a correlated slip. ⚠️ Sam's 1.8x floor is applied to that upper bound, which is sound in one direction only: a slip whose upper bound misses the floor can never reach it. The ceiling is deliberately NOT applied, because an upper bound above it may be inside it once the book discounts.

sgp_rule: Same-game parlays from this card's own rows, ordered by each slip's WEAKEST leg — that leg's own record at its exact line. ⛔ No combined chance is shown and no EV is: the legs are in one game, so multiplying their records would assert they are independent when they are not. The payout is the straight product of the prices, which is the MOST a book pays for a correlated slip.
parlay_rule: Legs are in DIFFERENT GAMES and at the SAME BOOK. ⛔ Every number is the player's own record — nothing here is a model output, and the combined figure is those records multiplied, which assumes the games are unrelated.

calibration_warning: ⚠️ These confidence numbers are running high. On this card's own record, when it said 80-90%, those plays hit 40.8% (49 graded); when it said 90-100%, those plays hit 54.5% (11 graded). Treat every confidence below as overstated. under-60 hit 46.6% against a claimed 49.5% (-3 pts, n=58); 60-70 hit 50% against a claimed 65.1% (-15.1 pts, n=48); 70-80 hit 68.8% against a claimed 75.9% (-7.2 pts, n=32); 80-plus hit 43.3% against a claimed 85.9% (-42.5 pts, n=60). The under-60 band is currently the closest to its own claim. 198 graded NFL plays behind these figures and small samples throughout -- every one of them will move.
board_rule: Sorted by the player's own record at that exact line, highest first — the same order the MLB board uses. Rows with no record sit below every row that has one.
no_model_note: 🔴 No row on this board carries a Gizmo's confidence rating and none ever will on today's evidence. Four pre-registered football models were tested and every one lost to a player's own season average. What is shown is his OWN RECORD and the market's price — both labelled.
